messages:
Priya: Kicking off the Velaris pilot. Goal = validate 3 real-world flows, prove latency/cost targets, and hand off runbook. Samir (Velaris) is on the kickoff call today. Need alignment on scope, success criteria, owners, and a tight timeline.

Evan: I'll lead evals + prompt engineering. Proposed success criteria: p95 latency < 350ms (hosted) OR consistent sub-500ms on Dedicated; per-response token cost < $0.05 for typical prompts; domain accuracy >= 85% on labeled eval set (F1). Also measure hallucination rate < 5% on critical QA prompts. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Aisha: Suggest three prioritized use cases from our discovery: 1) Support summarization (structured summary + follow-ups), 2) Policy QA (extractive + citation links), 3) Product recommendations (contextual suggestions). For each we need 20-30 representative prompts + golden labels. I'll prep starter prompts — sample below: 

```
# Support summarization prompts
1) "Summarize the customer's issue and list next steps in 3 bullets."
2) "Extract the product, error code, and suggested troubleshooting step."

# Policy QA prompts
1) "Is this message allowed under policy X? Answer Yes/No and cite clause."

# Recommendation prompts
1) "Given user context, suggest top 3 SKUs with 1-sentence rationale."
```

Evan: For evals we'll run baseline on Redwood hosted first (fastest to iterate). If Velaris needs deterministic latency, recommend Dedicated trial. Private/VPC option needs customer infra lead and ~6-8 week lead time for deployment.

Marco: Security side update: sent back the security questionnaire answers (SSO, KMS, encryption in transit+at-rest). Waiting on Velaris to confirm data residency and whether logs can contain PII. Also asked about contract SLAs and required certs (SOC2/ISO). If they require on-prem, that changes timeline.

Priya: Tentative timeline: Week 0 (this week) — discovery + dataset checklist. Week 1 — customer uploads sample data + we collect prompts. Week 2 — baseline runs + quick tuning. Week 3 — iterate on prompts, quantization/batching as needed. Week 4 — final eval, cost report, and handoff. Can Velaris assign 1 PM + 1 engineer for labeling/QA?

Marco: Pricing note for the trial: allocate 10k credits for the pilot (covers hosted runs and a few dedicated hours). If we need Dedicated for the full pilot, price will convert to a short-term reserved commit — I'll coordinate with finance.

Priya: Success metrics checklist to share with customer:
- List of 3 prioritized flows (owner)
- 20-30 labeled prompts per flow
- Baseline perf: p50/p95 latency, cost per response, token usage
- Quality targets (accuracy/F1, hallucination rate)
- Rollout criteria (pass 2/3 metrics)

Aisha: Discovery questions for Velaris to answer before next sync:
- Which datasets can you share for labeling? Any privacy constraints?
- Expected concurrency / peak RPS for the flow?
- What are acceptable latency SLOs for end-users?
- Are embeddings/rerank part of the use case?
- Who signs off on quality (names + roles)?

Evan: Quick tech checklist for customer: provide sample logs, example prompt-response pairs, representative average length (tokens), and any vendor blacklists. Also whether they need function calls / structured outputs.

Samir (Velaris): thanks, will confirm dataset availability and allocate an engineer. prefer Hosted first, maybe Dedicated later.

Priya: Great. Next steps: Evan + Aisha to send prompt template and eval harness by EOD. Marco to attach the security Q answers and the trial pricing note. I've scheduled a 30m kickoff review for Wed 10am PT — infra-bot created the invite. Please react with :thumbsup: if good.

infra-bot: Calendar invite created: "Velaris Pilot Kickoff" Wed 10:00-10:30 PT. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/velaris-pilot-kickoff

Evan: :thumbsup: I'll prep the baseline job and share a quick runbook for data ingestion.

Aisha: :raised_hands: I'll assemble prompt templates and a small labeling guide.
